name: TOTP Sign-In Success
summary: A returning user whose durable account has already been identified supplies a valid time-based one-time authenticator code and establishes an authenticated application session through the TOTP continuation path.
finalOutcome: The submitted TOTP proof is accepted for the existing durable identity and an authenticated application session is active.

sourceReferences.note: Typed handler resolves the durable identity and delegates TOTP proof validation to the real AppUserMfaManager.
Stable browser and mobile entry points adapt the same accepted TOTP proof into the appropriate application session model.
Real-path integration proof covers valid TOTP verification and session establishment without mocking the MFA/domain operation.
Generated createTotpLogin and createTotpToken operations provide the stable client contracts consumed by Angular and React Native.
